docTitle: Baibol mɛpu zuɣu · Baibol yim zuɣu
metaDesc: Dolim’ Alikauli Kura saha soli, Yisa biɛhigu, mini Pool chandi mɛpu yɛlimaŋli zuɣu — Baibol daa niŋ luɣ’ yɛlimaŋli ni.

s.title: Baibol mɛpu zuɣu
s.verse: “Pa kurimbuni lahibaya din pa yɛlimaŋli ka ti daa zaŋ wuhi ya ti Duuma Yisa Masia yiko min’ o kandina yɛla, amaa ti nyɛla shɛhiranim’ bɛn nini daa nya o jilima.” (2 Pita 1:16)
s.purpose: Baibol pala silimin. Di nyɛla niriba ban’ daa chana tiŋgban’ yɛlimaŋli, dabsa mini yuya maŋmaŋ’ zuɣu lahabali sabbu. Ŋma soya maa mɛpu zuɣu, saha soli ni — ŋma luɣ’ shɛli, bee ŋmɛ ▶ ka a doli li nabili nabili.
s.ot_kick: ① Alikauli Kura — saha soli ni
s.ot_h: Namda hal ti paai labbu na Jɛrusalɛm
s.ot_lead: Pala chandi yini koya, amaa nyɛla tiligibu lahabali soli din yina namda ni: namda mini lubu → kom titali mini Babɛl → boligu (Ibrahima) → alikauli tiŋgbɔŋ → Yibu → mɔɣili → tiŋgbɔŋ deebu → nam → pɔrigibu → zuliagu → labbu na.
s.je_lead: Dolim’ Yisa biɛhigu kaman Lahibali Suŋ litaafinim’ ni tɔɣisi li shɛm, soli ni — o dɔɣibu Bɛtlɛhɛm ni, o baptisibu mini o tuma Galili, gari Samaria, hal ti paai daɣiʒirili, yiɣisibu, mini duibu saazuɣu Jɛrusalɛm ni.
s.pa_h: Antiɔk hal ti paai dunia tarisi — Rom
s.pa_lead: Piligi Pɛntikɔst Jɛrusalɛm ni, wula ka Lahibali Suŋ yɛɣi gari Judia — gari Ɛsia Bila mini Yurɔp hal ti paai naam titali sunsuuni. Pii chandi anu maa puuni yini (pilli · ayi · ata + chandi din chaŋ Rom + sarika yibu nyaaŋa) ka doli Tuumba Tuma yɛltɔɣa mini gbana din bɔ ni bɛ sabi soli zuɣu.
s.foot: Din bɔ na · Luɣnima doli Baibol sabbu mini Baibol tiŋgban’ baŋsim (ni pumpɔŋɔ yuya luɣ’ shɛli di ni sɔŋ). Teeku noya, kulinima, mini mɔɣnima, bɛ zaŋ li tiŋgban’ baŋsim din yɔɔ (Natural Earth) ni na, ka balgi li.

eden.name: Edɛn (Namda · Lubu)
eden.note: Dunia bɛ ni nam ka di viɛla pam ŋɔ ni, alahichi kpe na ka ŋmaai Naawuni mini ninsala sunsuuni.
events: Namda dabsa ayobu ni — “di viɛl’ pam”
Ninsala bɛ ni nam Naawuni nahingbaŋ ni
Lubu, mini Edɛn ni yibu
Lahibali Suŋ pilli — “paɣ’ zuliya maa ni ti ŋme m-bɔr’ a zuɣu”

noah.name: Ararat (Kom Titali)
noah.today: Ararat Zoli, Turkiya wulinluhili polo zuŋɔ
noah.note: Naawuni kari dunia din pali ni alahichi saria, amaa o guli nyɛvili doɣim yini zuɣu.
events: Dunia din pali ni biɛri
Kom titali maa, mini Nɔhu ŋariŋ
Saŋmariga alikauli — “n ku lan chɛ ka kom di binnɛma zaa”

babel.name: Babɛl Duu
babel.note: Karimbaani din bɔri saazuɣu paabu zuɣu, Naawuni gari bɛ yɛtɔɣa ka wolgi niriba dunia ni.
events: “ti me timaŋmaŋ’ tiŋa, ka me pii tam … n-zali yuli”
Naawuni gari bɛ balli
Niriba wolgi dunia ni (Shinar — din daa ti leei Babilɔn)

ur.name: Ur
ur.note: Baibol tiligibu lahabali pili ni nir’ yino boligu.
events: Naawuni boli Ibrahima ka o yi Kaldiyanim’ Ur ni
“N ni chɛ ka a zuliya galisi pam … dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaani ti nya alibarika a zuɣu”
Yɛda ni ka o yi o tiŋgbɔŋ

haran.name: Haran
haran.note: Soli ni, o saɣindi boligu maa n-chana alikauli tiŋgbɔŋ polo.
events: Tera doɣim ʒini Haran
Tera kpi
Ibrahima yiɣisi n-chaŋ Kanana o yuun’ pihiyopɔin ni anu (75) ni

shechem.name: Shɛkɛm · Kanana
shechem.note: Alikauli tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka bɛ pili doɣim, ka alikauli maa gari zuliya kam sani.
events: Kanana kpɛbu, sara bimbini pilli — “N ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a zuliya”
Alikauli (Piligu 15) · Aisaku · Yaakubu
Yaakubu bidibisi pinaayi — zuliya pinaayi gbinni

egypt.name: Ijipti (Gɔshɛn)
egypt.note: Doɣim yini leei zuliya titali — din nyaaŋa ka bɛ leei dabsa.
events: Yisifu, bɛ ni kɔhi o, du n-leei Ijipti fukumsilana
Yaakubu doɣim zaa sheei na ni bɛ zɔ kɔm
Izraɛl zuliya din galsira bɛ zaŋ leei dabsa

sinai.name: Sinai Zoli
sinai.note: Alikauli Kura tiligibu titali — dabsa leei Naawuni niriba maŋmaŋa.
events: Daɣiri pia mini Gariba piɛɣu
Mɔɣ’ Ʒee ŋmaai ka bɛ gari
Zaligu pia, Zaligu, jɛmbu duu mini saradibu

kadesh.name: Kadɛsh (mɔɣili)
kadesh.note: Yɛda kɔŋbu chɛ ka zuliya yini kɔŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa — amaa Naawuni kul be bɛ sani.
events: Nininyaɣ’ pinaayi — amaa niriba zaɣisi niŋbu yɛda
Yuun’ pihitɔ (38) mɔɣili ni — manna, sakuɣu mini buɣum
Moab tiŋpiɔŋ ni, Musa waazu bahindili (Zaligu Teebu)

jericho.name: Jɛriko
jericho.note: Bahigu ni bɛ kpe n-deei alikauli tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
events: Jɔɔdan Kuliga ŋmaai ka niriba gari
Jɛriko gooni lu
Kanana deebu mini tiŋgbɔŋ pirigibu

shiloh.name: Shilo (Zuɣulaannima)
shiloh.note: Naa ni kani, sokam tumdila o suhu ni yu shɛm — naa maŋmaŋa n-tu ni o beni.
events: Bɛ zaani jɛmbu duu Shilo ni
Alahichi–namisibu–tiligibu soli din labisira (Dɛbora, Gidiɔn, Samson)
Rut — yɛlimaŋli saha biɛɣu ni, Dauda zuliya ni

jerusalem.name: Jɛrusalɛm · Nam Laɣiŋgu
jerusalem.note: Izraɛl saha suŋ maŋmaŋa — mini naa ŋun’ ni ʒiɛ sahakam alikauli.
events: Sool naa pilli, din nyaaŋa Dauda mini Goliat
Dauda alikauli — “a nam kul ni ʒiɛya sahakam” (2 Samuɛl 7)
Sulemaana mɛ jɛmbu duu Jɛrusalɛm ni

samaria.name: Samaria · Nam Pɔrigibu
samaria.note: Nam maa pɔrigi ka saɣim saha shɛli anabinima kuhira.
events: Sulemaana nyaaŋa, di pɔrigi Juda mini Izraɛl
Buɣa jɛmbu din labisira
Ilaija, Aizaia, Jɛrimia kuhi “labmiya na” — n-moɣisi Masia

nineveh.name: Ninɛve (Ashiria)
nineveh.note: Bɛ zɔbi saɣisigu kam, ka guli polo daŋ lubu.
events: Ninɛve, Ashiria tiŋ’ kpɛŋ
Guli nam lu Ashiria nuu ni (722 ALK)
Bɛ tim Jona Ninɛve ni

babylon.name: Babilɔn
babylon.note: Yuŋ din biɛɣ’ pam — amaa yiɣisibu alikauli na kul be.
events: Jɛrusalɛm lu, ka bɛ di jɛmbu duu buɣum (586 ALK)
Bɛ zaŋ Juda chaŋ Babilɔn
Daniɛl mini Ɛzɛkiɛl — yɛda mini ʒiʔima zuliagu ni

susa.name: Susa (Pɛrshia)
susa.note: Hal naam titali din jɛmdi buɣa sunsuuni, Naawuni guli o niriba.
events: Pɛrshia nyaŋ Babilɔn
Ɛsta tiligi Yahuudunima ka bɛ ku saɣim ba
Nɛhimia suhi Naawuni naa tɔni ka bɛ tim o

return.name: Labbu na Jɛrusalɛm
return.note: Bɛ labi na n-mɛ — amaa naa na bi kana. Bɛ gulindila Masia.
events: Labbu na siɣisili ata Sirus zaligu ni (Zɛrubabɛl 538 · Ɛzra 458 · Nɛhimia 444)
Jɛmbu duu mini Jɛrusalɛm gooni mɛbu yaha
Malaki — Alikauli Kura naara: “N timla n tumo”

bethlehem.name: Bɛtlɛhɛm
bethlehem.note: Masia bɛ ni niŋ alikauli kana Dauda tiŋ’ ni — Yɛligu din leei ninsala.
events: Bɛ dɔɣ’ o Bɛtlɛhɛm, Dauda tiŋ’ ni
Malaaika-nima moɣisi lahabali maa piɛhigulaannima sani
Yɛm baŋdiba kana ni bɛ ti jɛm o

nazareth.name: Nazarɛt
nazareth.note: Naawuni bili kaman ninsala tiŋ’ bɛla ni.
events: Bɛ bilisi o kapinta yiŋ’ ni
O yuun’ pinaayi ni, o bɔhira ka lahi labsiri jɛmbu duu ni
Din nyaaŋa bɛ zaɣisi o o tiŋ’ jama duu ni

jordan.name: Jɔɔdan Kuliga
jordan.note: O tuma pili — saazuɣu kɔhindi o kaman Bia.
events: Jɔn su o kɔm
Naawuni Shia sheei kaman ŋmɔ — “M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ”
O nyaŋ Sintani zaɣisibu buta mɔɣili ni

cana.name: Kana
cana.note: O alaama pilli ni, o wuhi o jilima.
events: Sana amiliya pɔri ni
Kɔm leei wain — o alaama pilli
O nyaandoliba niŋ o yɛda

sychar.name: Saikar (Samaria)
sychar.note: Tuma piligu soli — gari Jɛrusalɛm hal ti paai Samaria bɛ ni je.
events: O sɔŋ jɛmbu duu Jɛrusalɛm ni
Yuŋ, Nikodimus — “faashee bɛ maan labi dɔɣ’ a”
Nyɛvili kɔm ti Samaria paɣa

capernaum.name: Kapɛnaum
capernaum.note: Galili tuma yiŋ’ — boligu, wuhibu mini tuhibu zaa laɣim kpe.
events: O boli zahimkpɛriba ka zaŋ kpe leei o yiŋ’
Zoli Zuɣu Waazu — “Ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn ʒe yim ni bɛ pɔri Naawuni sani mal’ alibarika”
Nam ŋaha — mini tuhibu din duhira

galilee.name: Galili Teeku
galilee.note: Ni yaa binnamda zuɣu, o wuhi ŋun’ o nyɛ.
events: “Fom’ baalim” — o chɛ ka pɔhim maa fo
O zaŋ paanɔɔ anu mini zahim ayi dihi niriba tusa anu (5,000)
O chana kɔm zuɣu

caesarea_p.name: Sizaria Filipi
caesarea_p.note: Nyaandoliba baŋ ni o nyɛ Masia, ka daɣiʒirili soli yɔɔ.
events: Pita yɛlimaŋli — “A nyɛla Masia, Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ Bia”
O daŋ moɣisi o kubu mini o yiɣisibu
O nyɔɔ taɣi jilima ni zoli zuɣu

jericho.name: Jɛriko
jericho.note: Soli zuɣu din du chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm, o bɔri din bɔrgi.
events: O chɛ ka zom’ Bartimeus nya
O boli lampo deera Zakiyus
“Daadam Bia mi kamina ni o ti bo n-nya bɛn bɔrigi la n-tiligi ba”

bethany.name: Bɛtani
bethany.note: O wuhi o yaa kum zuɣu o yɔɔŋɔ bahindili tɔni.
events: O yiɣisi Lazarus siɣa ni — “Mani n-nyɛ nyɛvili, mani n-lan su kum ni neebu yiko”
Mariama yɔ o kpam o pambu zuɣu
Alaama ŋɔ chɛ ka bɛ ku o niabu kpaŋsi

jerusalem.name: Jɛrusalɛm
jerusalem.note: Din Baibol zaa wuhira bahindili — daɣiʒirili, yiɣisibu, mini duibu saazuɣu.
events: Kpɛbu ni jilima; o lan birigi jɛmbu duu teebulinima
Zaawuni Dibu Bahindili ni o paɣi o nyaandoliba naba
O kpi daɣiʒirili zuɣu
O yiɣisi dabsili ata zuɣu, din nyaaŋa o du saazuɣu

antioch.name: Antiɔk
antioch.note: Timbu chɛchi din puuni ka bɔɔbɔɔ nim’ tuma pili ka lan labri na.
events: Suhirigu ni, Naawuni Shia gaɣi Barnabas mini Sool
Chɛchi din puuni ka bɛ daŋ boli niŋ yɛda niriba “Kristabihi”
Chandi pilli, ayi mini ata piligu luɣili

seleucia.name: Sɛlukia
seleucia.note: Antiɔk ŋarim’ zɔŋ’ — bɛ kul chaŋ Saiprus.

salamis.name: Salamis (Saiprus)
salamis.note: Saiprus zɔŋ pilli — moɣisibu jama duunima ni.

paphos.name: Pafos
paphos.note: Bɛ wuhi yaa ban’ zaɣisi Lahibali Suŋ zuɣu.
events: Bɛ chɛ ka baɣa Ɛlimas leei zom
Gɔmnanti Sɛjiɔs Pool niŋ yɛda
Kpe na ka “Pool” gbaai tɔni

perga.name: Pɛga
perga.note: Pamfilia ŋarim’ zɔŋ’ — kpe na ka Jɔn Maak labi.

pantioch.name: Pisidia Antiɔk
pantioch.note: Lahibali Suŋ yɔɔ chaŋ bɔɔbɔɔ nim’ polo.
events: Tiligibu lahabali waazu waɣinli jama duu ni
Bɔɔbɔɔ nim’ pam niŋ suhupiɛlli n-deei Yɛligu maa
Tuhibu chɛ ka bɛ kari ba yiŋa

iconium.name: Ikoniɔm
iconium.note: Niriba pam niŋ yɛda, amaa namisibu chɛ ka bɛ chɛ.

lystra.name: Listra
lystra.note: Bɛ boli o wuni, din nyaaŋa bɛ labi o kuɣa.
events: O tibgi doo ŋun’ daa dɔɣi ka o naba kɔŋ yaa
Zamaatu bɔ ni bɛ maani sara ti ba kaman wuninima
Bɛ labi o kuɣa n-chɛ o ka o nyɛla kaman kpiŋ, ka o yiɣisi

derbe.name: Dɛbe
derbe.note: Bɛ mali nyaandoliba pam; bɛ lan labri n-kpaŋsiri chɛchinima.

troas.name: Troas
troas.note: Taɣibu luɣili polo Lahibali Suŋ daŋ chaŋ Yurɔp.
events: Makɛdonia doo ʒiʔili
“Kam’ Masidɔnia na ti sɔŋ ti”
Bɛ gari yɔm chaŋ Yurɔp

philippi.name: Filipai
philippi.note: Yurɔp chɛchi pilli — Lahibali Suŋ nyaŋ hal sarika ni.
events: Lidia, chinchin’ ʒiɔɔ kɔhira, niŋ yɛda
Bɛ yɔɔ paɣ’ dabli ŋun’ baɣisira
Yuŋsunsuuni yila, tiŋgbɔŋ damli, sarika gulana doɣim tiligi

thess.name: Tɛsalɔnaika
thess.note: Yɛligu maa dam tiŋ’ maa ka tuhibu duhi.
events: O yɛn yɛltɔɣa jama duu ni Vuhim daba ata
“Ninvuɣ’ shɛb’ bɛn lɛbigiri dunia pindi tiŋ’ la”
Bɛ yɔɔ yuŋ

berea.name: Bɛria
berea.note: Bɛn’ daa “viɛla” ban’ vihi Yɛligu maa bɛ maŋmaŋa.
events: Bɛ deei Yɛligu maa ni suhupiɛlli
Dabsili kam bɛ vihiri Baibol sabbu ni bɛ nya di yɛlimaŋli
Bɛ pam ti niŋ yɛda

athens.name: Atɛns
athens.note: Yɔɔm baŋdiba tiŋ’ ni, o moɣisi “wuni bɛ ni ʒi”.
events: Tiŋ’ din pali ni buɣa chɛ ka o suhu saɣim
Areopagus zuɣu o moɣisi Nam’ lana mini yiɣisibu
Bɛ maŋsi o, amaa bɛ shɛb’ niŋ yɛda

corinth.name: Kɔrint
corinth.note: O ʒini yuuni mini di pirigili, n-mɔ chɛchi tiŋ’ din pali ni biɛri ni.
events: O mali buɔɔ tuma mini Akwila ni Prisila
“Di zɔri dabiɛm … M be a sani”
Kɔrint niriba pam niŋ yɛda ka bɛ su ba kɔm

ephesus.name: Ɛfɛsus
ephesus.note: Chandi ata suhu — Yɛligu maa yɔɔ Ɛsia zaa ni.
events: Wuhibu dabsili kam yuun’ ayi Tiranus karim duu ni
Bɛ di baɣisim gbana buɣum; tuun’ kpiɔŋ
Anzinfa maali Dɛmɛtɔɔs yiɣisi zɔbu

miletus.name: Miletus
miletus.note: Kɔnsɔɔ ni o gɔri Ɛfɛsus chɛchi kpamba.
events: “Naawuni Cheechi shɛli o ni daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ’ Bia ʒim fa m-bahi la”
Kpamba kɔni, dama bɛ mi ni bɛ ku lan nya o

caesarea.name: Sizaria
caesarea.note: Yuun’ ayi ni o gɔhi Lahibali Suŋ gɔmnantinima mini naa tɔni.
events: Saria karibu gɔmnanti Fɛliks mini Fɛstus tɔni
O gɔhi o maŋa Naa Agripa tɔni
“N ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋ Naa Siiza sani” — n-chaŋ Rom

jerusalem.name: Jɛrusalɛm
jerusalem.note: Bɛ gbaai o jɛmbu duu ni, ka o sarika soli pili.
events: Zamaatu gbaai o jɛmbu duu ni
O gɔhi o maŋa saria karimba tɔni
Kaman Rom nira, bɛ zaŋ o chaŋ Sizaria ni guuriba

myra.name: Maira
myra.note: Bɛ taɣi Alɛkzandria ŋariŋ’ din chana Rom.

fairhaven.name: Zɔŋ’ Suŋ (Krit)
fairhaven.note: Bɛ zaɣisi Pool saɣisigu ni bɛ chɛ ŋarim’ chandi.

crete.name: Krit
crete.note: O yibu sarika ni nyaaŋa, tiŋgbɔŋpɔ din o chɛ Taitus ni o mali chɛchinim’ sɔŋ.
events: O chɛ Taitus ni o gaɣi kpamba tiŋ’ kam ni
O bɔri kpamba ban’ ka galimsi, ban’ mali yɛda
O sabi gbaŋ’ zaŋ ti Taitus

malta.name: Malta
malta.note: Gari pɔhikpaŋa mini ŋarim’ saɣimbu, Naawuni alikauli kul zani.
events: “Wulinluhili pɔhim” saɣim ŋariŋ’ maa, amaa niriba kɔbisiyi ni pihiyopɔin (276) zaa tilgi
Waɣ’ dɔm’ o, ka o bi tɔ shɔŋɔ
O tibgi tiŋgbɔŋ maa baranima

syracuse.name: Sairakus
syracuse.note: Bɛ ʒini dabsa ata Sisili ni.

puteoli.name: Putiɔli
puteoli.note: Bɛ sheei Itali ka mabihi niŋ yɛda taɣi ba.

rome.name: Rom
rome.note: Lahibali Suŋ paai naam titali suhu bahigu ni — pa naabu, amaa piligu.
events: Yuun’ ayi o be sarika ni yiŋ’ ka moɣisiri nam maa ni suhukpaŋsim
Kpe na ka o sabi Sarika Gbana (Ɛfɛsus·Filipai·Kɔlɔsai·Failimɔn)
Din nyaaŋa bɛ lan niŋ o sarika, ka o sabi 2 Timoti ka bɛ ku o — “N tuhi tuhiri suŋ; n zo tizɔbo la naai”
